title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Missing-Accessory Charges: Agent Tool Reference
content:
Accessories that do not come back with a Ridgeline Tool Rental unit are billed as a missing-accessory fee line on the agreement. This is the agent reference for booking that line.

## Capability

`bill_missing_accessories_12fefdd6` books a single missing-accessory fee line, dated today, for accessories not returned with the unit on one returned Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement, and raises the amount the renter owes on the agreement by exactly the amount billed. The renter sees the charge as its own fee line and a higher balance. The amount is passed in already decided; the tool does not work it out.

## How it is invoked

Agent-side tool: the Customer Care agent unlocks `bill_missing_accessories_12fefdd6` and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `rental_agreement_id` | The reference number of the rental agreement (one equipment item) the charge is billed on, as returned by the rental agreement lookup. |
| `accessory_amount` | The missing-accessory charge in USD: a positive number with 2 decimal places and no currency sign, stored by standard rounding to 2 decimal places. |

## Return

The receipt returns `status` ("billed" when the fee line was booked), `rental_charge_id` (the reference of the new fee line), `rental_agreement_id` (the agreement it was booked on), `fee_type` (always `missing_accessory`), `amount` (the charge billed, USD with 2 decimal places) and `balance_due` (the amount now owed on the agreement, USD with 2 decimal places).

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

`accessory_amount` 45.00 on an agreement owing 0.00 returns `status` "billed", `fee_type` `missing_accessory`, `amount` 45.00 and `balance_due` 45.00.
